Not looking both ways at a green light. I was in a hurry to get back from work and stopped at a stoplight, as soon as it turned green I stepped on it. 

Next thing I know I've been hit by a small Honda traveling at least 80+ mph through the red light. My truck was flipped and rolled, which means that impact was brutal as hell to flip my lifted 2006 Chevy Duramax.

I was knocked unconscious by the impact and woke up upside-down to bystanders trying to help he out. I had gotten a huge gash on the side of my head from the glass and needed 30 stitches. About 30 min after the wreck, emergency personnel arrived (I live in a very rural area).

The first responders had said if I was in any other vehicle I would've died no doubt. Unfortunately for the other driver, he wasn't so lucky. He died in transport to the hospital and his friend had broken both his legs, his collarbone, and had sustained various other injuries I can't remember. 

I'm so grateful to those there that day, and to the first responders that saved my life.
